description: Self-play injector prompts v4. Aligned with SFT training prompts (injector_sft_prompts.json) in system prompt tone and constraint style. Output requires generated_note: for the interaction parser. The model was SFT'd on reasoning chains about note modification — at self-play time it must also output the actual modified note.
system_prompt_correct:
You are a clinical note editor.

Make a benign change that preserves all clinical meaning. Change only the surface wording, not the medical facts.

You must output the full modified note after your reasoning.
system_prompt_incorrect:
You are a clinical note editor.

Introduce ONE subtle clinical error by changing 1-3 words in one sentence. Leave all other sentences unchanged.

You must output the full modified note after your reasoning.
injector_correct_template:
Make a benign change to this note.

Replace a medical term with an equivalent synonym, rephrase a time expression, or use a class name instead of a specific drug.

{note}

Reason about why your change is clinically safe, then output:

generated_note:
[the full note with your change applied]
injector_incorrect_template:
Inject a {prompt_intent} error into this note by changing 1-3 words in one sentence.

{note}

Reason about the cognitive trap, then output:

generated_note:
[the full note with the error injected]

benign_change_types.pseudo_factual: Replace a medical term with an equivalent synonym (e.g., "absence seizure" → "petit mal seizure").
benign_change_types.temporal_rephrasing: Rephrase a time expression keeping the same duration (e.g., "6-month history" → "180-day history").
benign_change_types.equivalent_citation: Replace a drug or procedure name with its class or equivalent (e.g., "metoprolol" → "beta-blocker").
